name: code-buddy
description: Holds risky tool calls (production domains, live Stripe keys, protected-branch pushes, deploys, destructive commands) for your OK, replays each turn's edits, and tracks every subagent's progress, tokens and cost.

productionDomains.title: Production domains
productionDomains.description: Comma-separated hosts; *.example.com matches every subdomain. A shell command, web request or browser call that targets one is held. Leave empty to skip the domain rule.

stagingDomains.title: Staging domains
stagingDomains.description: Comma-separated hosts. Production wins on overlap: only an exact host listed here (no wildcard) is let through.

protectedBranch.title: Protected branch
protectedBranch.description: Pushes to it and merges into it are held. Comma-separated; * matches within a name.

guard.title: Guard
guard.description: On holds risky calls; off lets everything through (replay and agents keep working).
